reuse.why: Extends the existing WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay helpers and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and month utils for the new handler instead of reimplementing date logic.

duplication.why: Core rule lives once in shared/schedules.ts, but the config-to-WeekendRule literal is rebuilt identically in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, and lookahead/occurrence-window logic is repeated across getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Weekend/holiday rule changes sit in the shared schedules module, the new handler is registered in the schedules server app, and the type field is added to RecurConfig.

scope.why: Changes are all on the requested features; the schedule-template loop rewrite is needed for nullable results, though the release note covers only the last step.

maintainability.why: One shared rule function decides move/skip/holiday handling for every path; the heuristic lookahead constants (7 occurrences, 2 per holiday, count*7) are a bit fragile but documented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) go through applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated WeekendRule literal in app.ts is plain repetition, not disguised; no reshaped copies of the rule logic.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays fields and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; applyWeekendRule gains a frequency==='daily' branch returning null. Growth is modest and in line with the requested rules.
